author: seed@build
title: RSI regime threshold x ADX gate on 9 large caps (does an ADX gate cut whipsaw net of 0.30% costs?)
rationale: Expected sign: ADX>=20 gate raises Sharpe and cuts entries (fewer whipsaws, lower cost drag at Bybit EU 0.30%/side) with at most a small CAGR loss; up=60 lowers exposure further. Playbook finding: the reliable lever is few trades + going to cash in downtrends. Small grid (12 specs) on purpose: brute force overfits (overnight 6.3% vs 9.4% random). Partially contaminated: ADX{0,20,25} x RSI was in the 960-config study whose TEST was opened; a look is only worth spending once the vault cutoff moves past 2026-10-13.
